scope: Temporary native five-update probe; no persistent production or training-configuration changes.

criterion.criterion: At least twice the warmed optimizer throughput, with the same five-update seeded standing workload, preserved inference action parity and unchanged public backend aliases.

limitations: One run per configuration under concurrent standing and travel training; timings do not establish a statistically reliable gain.
Each trial verified 512 valid samples per update; parameter hashes, PPO metrics and cross-configuration action parity were not compared.
No candidate met the predeclared throughput threshold, so feature patches were reverted before correctness/parity qualification.
The input checkpoint failed standing selection; timing does not qualify a controller.
decision: Retain the baseline native features and profile. Preserve immutable live training binaries. Optimize the PPO path only after a separate measured experiment meets its acceptance criteria.
